#### Inter-individual differences 
We all have the intuition that we are unique individuals; but how unique is your brain (activity)? Researcher, including myself, have pioneered techniques to study this question. 

![brain-fingerprinting across the lifespan](b-fp-life.png)

[Finn and colleagues in 2015](https://www.nature.com/articles/nn.4135) first put forward the idea of a brain-fingerprint: *brain activity that  differentiates you from a cohort of people*.  Since then, the field has shown that individuals can be differentiated from one another using [brief 30-second recordings of brain activity](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25895-8), the features that set us apart from one another [differ across the lifespan](https://www.cell.com/cell-reports/fulltext/S2211-1247(25)01429-9), and that these [brain-fingerprints are heritable](https://www.science.org/doi/full/10.1126/sciadv.ads7544).
